form:FormGroup.label: Id
form:FormGroup.helpText: Unique ID of this component on the dashboard, generated when the component is added (e.g. vis-AB1C2). It cannot be changed.

form:FormGroup.label: Name
form:FormGroup.helpText: Name of this component, shown in its tab on the dashboard.

form:FormGroup.label: Table
form:FormGroup.helpText: Table that supplies the data for this visualisation.

form:FormGroup.label: Visualisation
form:FormGroup.helpText: Visualisation document used to draw the chart. Choosing one adds its settings tabs. You need Use permission on it.
